e: Named for type locality El Paso County, Colorado, + -lite.

q: And another thing — there's a new elpee from The Supa anytime now. The B-side here features new singer Puddy Roots, well worth a listen.
The recently discovered elpistostegid Tiktaalik probably already had a pair of fins, which could function like vertebrate limbs in shallow waters.
